description: Assemble supplied approved terms into a clear, internally consistent offer draft and manager notes; never extend or send the offer.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when a hiring owner requests a draft offer letter or negotiation brief for a candidate whose offer decision is already in scope.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: candidate name or approved placeholder; role/title/level; work location and employment type; approved base/equity/bonus/benefits terms; start date; reporting manager; approved clause/template; authorized hiring decision owner and source refs.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: offer letter draft with component table and terms; manager-only notes identifying gaps, inconsistencies and factual options; no external communication.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm this is drafting, not a request to decide whether to hire or set compensation. 2. Retrieve only approved role/candidate facts from visible native sources; prefer a candidate reference over sensitive identifiers. 3. Check each term against the provided approval or source: title, entity, location, employment type, pay currency/period, equity units and vesting, bonus, benefits, start date, manager. 4. Calculate first-year stated cash components only when amounts and period are explicit; show exclusions and do not value unpriced equity as cash. 5. Draft using the approved template; preserve required exact wording and mark missing terms as placeholders rather than inventing them. 6. Add a separate manager note for unapproved terms, ambiguities, and negotiation choices. 7. Save only to the requested private draft artifact. Routine draft composition needs no additional approval; do not update ATS/HRIS, sign, send, promise, or finalize.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
